blocks.task_summary: Expand (1+ax)^(-1/2) and (1-x)^(1/2) via binomial theorem up to x², equate coefficients to the given form 4bx + bx², and solve for a and b.
method_path: Form the difference and collect terms: ½(1−a)x + ⅛(3a²+1)x² + …
Equate coefficients: ½(1−a) = 4b and ⅛(3a²+1) = b
Solve simultaneously to obtain a = −1/3, b = 1/6

evidence.basis: M1 for attempt to expand binomial with negative fractional power; A1 for (1+ax)^(-1/2) = 1 − ½ax + ⅜a²x² + …; A1 for (1−x)^(1/2) = 1 − ½x − ⅛x² + …; M1 for attempt to equate coefficients; M1 for attempt to solve simultaneously; A1 for a = −1/3, b = 1/6.

method_path: State |x| < 1 as the condition for validity of the binomial expansions
